identity.name: LexiFlow
identity.description: A documentation reader that feels like a premium listening experience. Dark, immersive, and rhythm-based.

scale.reader_passive: text-xl md:text-2xl text-muted-foreground blur-[0.5px] transition-all duration-300

buttons.primary: bg-primary hover:bg-primary/90 text-white rounded-full px-8 py-6 font-medium transition-all hover:scale-105 active:scale-95 shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(109,40,217,0.3)]
buttons.secondary: bg-secondary hover:bg-secondary/80 text-white rounded-full px-6 py-4 font-medium border border-white/5

inputs.default: bg-secondary/50 border-transparent focus:border-primary/50 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary/50 rounded-xl h-12 px-4 transition-all

reader_view.container: max-w-3xl mx-auto h-[70vh] overflow-y-auto scroll-smooth no-scrollbar mask-image-gradient
reader_view.active_sentence: text-white scale-105 origin-left font-medium py-4 pl-4 border-l-4 border-primary bg-gradient-to-r from-primary/10 to-transparent
reader_view.passive_sentence: text-white/30 py-2 pl-4 border-l-4 border-transparent hover:text-white/50 transition-colors cursor-pointer

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. SETUP: Install 'lucide-react' and 'framer-motion'. Configure Tailwind with the colors provided in 'colors.palette'. Add the fonts to index.css.
2. THEME: Force Dark Mode by default. The app should feel like a 'Night Mode' IDE or Spotify.
3. READER UI: Implement the 'Spotify Lyrics' view. The active sentence must be vertically centered. Use 'scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' })' on the active element.
4. AUDIO PLAYER: Create a floating bottom bar (Glassmorphism) for playback controls. It should persist across pages.
5. AI CHAT: The chat sidebar should be collapsible. When open, it pushes the reader content or overlays with a glass effect. Use 'Space Grotesk' for the 'AI is thinking...' states.
6. LANDING PAGE: Use the 'hero_abstract' image as a subtle background with low opacity (20%) and a radial gradient overlay. Big, bold typography.
7. ACCESSIBILITY: Ensure high contrast. The 'passive' text in the reader must still be readable (min contrast 4.5:1 against bg) - adjust opacity if needed.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: DO NOT use gradients for text color.
DO NOT use generic 'Inter' font. Use the specified fonts.
Avoid 'container' class for main layouts; use custom max-width wrappers for better control.
